docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This script uses the pyvisa library to communicate with external hardware over VISA protocol (e.g., GPIB, USB, RS232). It’s used to query device identity and test connectivity.

docs.title: This script sets up a Data Acquisition (DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in
It defines which channels to use, the timing of the acquisition,
and how the DAQ system starts and stops.
docs.text:
Setup python Copy Edit import nidaqmx # Import the NI-DAQmx Python library.

task = nidaqmx.Task() # Create a new task object to manage all DAQ operations. Channel Configuration python Copy Edit task.ai_channels.add_ai_voltage_chan("Dev1/ai0", min_val=-10.0, max_val=10.0) # Add AI0 channel with ±10V input range. Clock and Sampling Rate python Copy Edit task.timing.cfg_samp_clk_timing( # Configure the sample clock timing. rate=1000, # Set sampling rate to 1000 samples/sec. sample_mode=nidaqmx.constants.AcquisitionType.CONTINUOUS # Use continuous acquisition mode. ) Task Execution python Copy Edit task.start() # Start the task to begin data acquisition. python Copy Edit

docs.title: Example: Read data from buffer, process or log to file.
docs.text: python Copy Edit task.stop() # Stop the task after acquisition is complete. python Copy Edit task.close() # Release the task and free system resources. Output Summary python Copy Edit

docs.title: - Analog input channel AI0 is configured for ±10V.
- Sampling rate is set to 1000 Hz in continuous mode.
- Task can now be integrated into any acquisition or logging loop.
